summary: Tower on Johnson Mountain near Potosi in the Clark National Forest; a 1963 photo record shows a lookout station and telephone tower. No source describes the site today.

Missouri Historical Society photo record dated 1963-08-03 of a lookout station and Southwestern Bell Telephone Company tower at Johnson Mountain near Potosi

notes_for_editor: Thin record. Location conflict: the Forest Lookouts page files the site under Iron County, while the 1939 report and the 1963 photo record both say 'near Potosi' (Potosi is a separate town). No build date, height, design or fate found. Photo record licence not checked, so no photo added; publisher name taken from the mohistory.org record. The 1939 item is a newspaper report reproduced on the Forest Lookouts page, not checked against the original paper.
